events.notes: Leave home by 14:00 to arrive on time.

events.notes: Pupils gather 17:00, concert 18:00. Family warmly welcome. From Isak Andersson. No drum lessons in v.50, only concerts.

events.notes: Fly out Tue 22 Dec (or Mon 21 Dec, TBC). Back in Sweden for New Year's Eve.
events.notes_sv: Utresa tis 22 dec (eller mån 21 dec, TBC). Tillbaka i Sverige till nyårsafton.
